events.title: Welcome to the Museum: Demo 0.6.2 Steam Next Fest Update
events.summary: Welcome to Chinese Board Game Museum. For Steam Next Fest, we have rearranged the exhibition and invite you back to the streets and courtyards of China in the 1980s and 1990s. Each of our six games has a home: Dou Dizhu in a Wuhan alley on a summer night, Guan Dan beside the canals of Huai’an, Pao De Kuai on a Changsha rooftop in autumn, Ka Wu Xing in a Xiaogan hall in winter, and Sichuan Mahjong in a Chengdu teahouse in early spring. events.title: Chinese Board Game Museum: Steam Next Fest Gameplay Tour
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here! We are YANDRA STUDIO, and this is our gameplay introduction to Chinese Board Game Museum. The film follows the full journey from the map to exhibit details, the game setup screen and finally the table. It introduces Dou Dizhu, Guan Dan, Pao De Kuai, Sheng Ji, Sichuan Mahjong and Ka Wu Xing, alongside five city settings and the museum. events.title: Demo 0.5.0 Update | Online Dou Dizhu & Gameplay Improvements
events.summary: Chinese Board Game Museum Demo 0.5.0 is now available! Online Dou Dizhu on Steam Join a game through public lobbies, friend rooms, or room codes. You can also invite friends through Steam. This update improves the ready-up, game start, results, and rematch flow, along with initial synchronization and connection recovery messages.
